newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to approve five offshore banking licences.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to approve five offshore banking licences.

text.p: Bank of Thailand governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Thursday that the applications of five foreign banks seeking Bangkok International Banking Facility (BIBF) licences have been sent to the finance ministry for final approval.

"The five applications have been sent to the finance minister for approval while two other applications which belong to Japanese banks are still awaiting for an approval from the Japanese finance ministry first before they could be sent to the minister," Rerngchai said.
The five applications from foreign banks, which Rerngchai did not mention by name, were sent to the finance minister after the central bank had scrutinised them for the second round.
The BIBF facility was set up in 1993 in Thailand's efforts to liberalise its financial system.
The finance ministry is expected to approve these seven new BIBF applications next year, which would bring the number of international banking facilities offices here to 45.
